note: One expectation index per contract directory. Each case names the structural violations that prove its point as (pointer, keyword) pairs; a validator's free-text message is deliberately never recorded. The expected set must be a subset of what the validator reports, because a conditional rule often reports a broader violation alongside the specific one.

finding-summary-missing.proves: Every member of a finding is required. A finding that states no summary is not a partially filled finding, it is a document nobody can act on, so it is refused rather than rendered with a gap.

limitation-missing.proves: The bound is mandatory. A finding read without what it does not establish is the most likely way this contract gets misused, so the document carries its own limitation rather than relying on a reader to know one.

business-impact-blank.proves: A product text that is present but empty is not a text. The shared single-line rule refuses it, so an unfilled template cannot travel as though it were an interpretation.

finding-summary-multiline.proves: A finding text stays a single bounded line. A newline would break a renderer, a log line and a header alike, and the shared rule refuses every C0 and C1 control rather than merely CR and LF.

evidence-refs-empty.proves: The rule this contract exists for: evidence is the Fact Authority. A finding that names no evidence is an assertion about a website nobody established anything about, and it is structurally not representable.

evidence-refs-duplicated.proves: The same evidence counted twice would overstate what a finding rests on. Uniqueness makes the reference list a set of distinct facts rather than a weighting.

rule-id-lowercase.proves: The rule vocabulary is open but not free text: it keeps a stable upper-snake shape, so a rule a later slice introduces stays a token rather than prose.

unrecognised-future-property.proves: The root is closed. A member a later slice might want cannot arrive early and unreviewed on the strength of a producer having written it.

score-property.proves: This slice introduces no scoring of any kind. A finding able to carry a score would settle the weighting question by accident, before any score model has been defined or authorised.

overall-intervention-level-property.proves: No severity, priority or intervention model exists yet. The closed root refuses the member outright, so an urgency nobody has defined cannot be attached to a finding and then read as though it were measured.

measurement-refs-property.proves: A finding may not bypass website evidence and point straight at a raw measurement. Evidence is where a statement about a site is allowed to be made at all, and the chain stays finding to evidence to measurement.
